verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly establishes the $5 coded-referral commission and separate Small and Big Block ticket awards.
Eliminating Big Blocks necessarily changes the coded-referral award from two block tickets to one Small Block ticket; overwriting the existing award key leaves no separate stale key to remove.
The message restates the existing one-ticket coded-referral reward in revised marketing language but does not materially change this Requirement.
First concrete verification that a coded-referral USDC mint awarded the referenced NFT both $5 and a prize ticket.
